svg.title: A Nested Merchant Acquisition Cohort
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-merchant-cohort-conversion; chart type: funnel; title: A Nested Merchant Acquisition Cohort; subtitle: 400 prospects become 25 active merchants over an illustrative 120 days.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage; these are planning counts, not observed conversion results. First deal timing remains 1–4 months. The separate ATM portfolio is excluded from this funnel.; caption: At steady state, 25 merchants retaining $15,000 annually each contribute $375,000; ten separately sourced ATM venues retaining $7,000 each complete the $445,000 Base revenue case.; stages: label: Named prospects; value: 400 merchants; 100% starting cohort; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Record identifiable businesses with permitted categories, reachable decision-makers, serviceable locations, and an explicit reason to reconsider their existing processing arrangement.; label: Qualified statement audits; value: 200 merchants; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Obtain authorized statements and confirm ownership, processing needs, renewal timing, current pricing, and risk fit before allocating proposal effort.; label: Documented proposals; value: 100 merchants; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Present itemized pricing and service terms; calculate retained contribution after upstream deductions rather than treating interchange or merchant settlement as revenue.; label: Complete sponsor submissions; value: 40 merchants; 40% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Submit complete applications with genuine business activity, required evidence, and disclosed processing history; submission does not imply sponsor acceptance.; label: Active retained accounts; value: 25 merchants; 62.5% of prior stage; numeric value: 25.0; detail: Count only live accounts with reconciled processing. Illustrative annual yield is $500,000 monthly merchant volume times 12 times a 0.25% retained spread, or $15,000.

rect.title: label: Named prospects; value: 400 merchants; 100% starting cohort; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Record identifiable businesses with permitted categories, reachable decision-makers, serviceable locations, and an explicit reason to reconsider their existing processing arrangement.

label: Qualified statement audits; value: 200 merchants; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Obtain authorized statements and confirm ownership, processing needs, renewal timing, current pricing, and risk fit before allocating proposal effort.

label: Documented proposals; value: 100 merchants; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Present itemized pricing and service terms; calculate retained contribution after upstream deductions rather than treating interchange or merchant settlement as revenue.

label: Complete sponsor submissions; value: 40 merchants; 40% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Submit complete applications with genuine business activity, required evidence, and disclosed processing history; submission does not imply sponsor acceptance.

label: Active retained accounts; value: 25 merchants; 62.5% of prior stage; numeric value: 25.0; detail: Count only live accounts with reconciled processing. Illustrative annual yield is $500,000 monthly merchant volume times 12 times a 0.25% retained spread, or $15,000.

text.title: Assumptions: Every stage is a subset of the preceding stage; these are planning counts, not observed conversion results. First deal timing remains 1–4 months. The separate ATM portfolio is excluded from this funnel.
